[1] (ran1_tdoc_chunks R1-2101725, sim=0.4177)
In this contribution, we observe and propose the following. Proposal 1: By default all NR features are supported by RedCap UEs (either optional or mandatory). Any exceptions of features that RedCap UEs are not allowed to support must be explicitly agreed. Observation 1: Per RAN#90e, so far the features not intended for RedCap ONLY include carrier aggregation, dual connectivity and wider bandwidths. Observation 2: RedCap may include as "basic features" any necessary or beneficial feature from NR across Rel-15 to Rel-17. Basic features are mandatory for RedCap UEs.
